name: Antenna Rotom (CobbleEffort form)
look: a round orange head with rabbit-ear antennas and braces, over a drippy body of glowing pink plasma
entry: It wiggles its rabbit-ear antennas to tune in to far-off signals, and grins its braced grin when it catches one.
how: Use a Rabbit-Ear Antenna on your Rotom (craft it round a Cell Battery; needs Mega Showdown); its Rotom Catalogue cycles through this form too. Learns Moonblast in this form.
